agent_memory.definition: Memory storage and retrieval mechanisms for autonomous agents
agent_memory.scope_note: Scientific paper retrieval alone is insufficient.

agent_communication.definition: Communication and coordination among autonomous agents
agent_communication.scope_note: General communication without agents is insufficient.

agent_tools.definition: Selection and use of external tools by autonomous agents

agent_planning.definition: Planning and multi-step reasoning by autonomous agents

learning_policy.definition: Optimization of decision policies in machine learning
learning_policy.scope_note: Public policy without learning is insufficient.

learning_graph.definition: Generalization and learning over graph structured data
learning_graph.scope_note: A graph used only as a display is insufficient.

learning_reward.definition: Design of reward signals for learning systems
learning_reward.scope_note: Financial rewards without learning are insufficient.

learning_exploration.scope_note: Exploratory data analysis alone is insufficient.

science_hypothesis.scope_note: Testing a supplied hypothesis without generation is insufficient.

science_retrieval.definition: Retrieval of scientific papers and research evidence
science_retrieval.scope_note: Memory retrieval without scientific literature is insufficient.

science_collaboration.definition: Collaboration among researchers and scientific teams

science_evaluation.definition: Evaluation of scientific research ideas and proposals
science_evaluation.scope_note: General evaluation of a model or algorithm alone is insufficient; object and assessment concepts must share a sentence.
